fixes: The Size line in the episode sheet is now white and the same size as the Quality / Audio / Server headings (14sp Bold) — it was small grey text and easy to miss.
When the size can't be checked, the sheet now says so honestly ("Size: couldn't check") instead of the line just vanishing.

Tapping Download no longer claims "Download queued" before the file is actually found — you see "Finding the file…" first, and "queued" only appears once the download really exists in the Downloads tab.
